content.value_statement: Vue 2 applications need package and rendering settings that match their framework version. This skill guides a focused markstream-vue2 setup with safe streaming and rendering defaults.
actual_capabilities: Confirms whether a project uses Vue 2.6 or Vue 2.7 before setup.
Recommends markstream-vue2 installation and CSS import order.
Configures MarkdownRender for streamed content and recovered chat history.
Recommends safe HTML policy and Mermaid strict mode by default.
Identifies Vue CLI, Webpack 4, and Vite worker-import cases that need another package.
limitations: It does not install packages or modify project files without your approval.
It targets Vue 2.6 and 2.7, not Vue 3 applications.
It does not replace project-specific build or security review.
Trusted HTML and relaxed Mermaid settings require a documented trust decision.

use_cases.title: Add Markdown rendering to a Vue 2 app
use_cases.description: Set up the package, stylesheet, and basic MarkdownRender component in an existing Vue 2.7 project.

use_cases.title: Build a streaming chat display
use_cases.description: Configure smooth streaming, cursor behavior, and transitions for partial assistant responses and completed history.

use_cases.title: Review legacy rendering settings
use_cases.description: Keep safe HTML and strict Mermaid defaults while scoping any approved legacy exception to one trusted surface.

prompt_templates.title: Basic setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add markstream-vue2 to this Vue 2.7 application. Check the existing entry file and show the smallest safe setup.

prompt_templates.title: Vue 2.6 compatibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Vue 2.6 project for markstream-vue2 compatibility. Tell me whether @vue/composition-api is needed and where to import the stylesheet.

prompt_templates.title: Streaming chat renderer
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure MarkdownRender for a Vue 2 chat interface. Stream active responses smoothly, then render completed history without streaming delay.

prompt_templates.title: Scoped legacy exception
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether this trusted legacy content surface needs relaxed HTML or Mermaid settings. Keep the exception scoped and explain the security tradeoff.

output_examples.input: Set up markstream-vue2 in a Vue 2.7 application.
output: Import its stylesheet after reset styles.
Render markdown with MarkdownRender and safe defaults.

output_examples.input: Make streamed chat messages feel smooth.
output: Use automatic smooth streaming for active messages.
Disable fade while content is streaming.
Turn off smooth streaming for final history messages.

best_practices: Confirm the Vue version and build tooling before selecting a package.
Keep html-policy set to safe and Mermaid strict mode enabled by default.
Validate changes with the smallest relevant development or build command.
anti_patterns: Do not add @vue/composition-api to Vue 2.7 projects without a project need.
Do not use streaming pacing for completed chat history.
Do not enable trusted HTML or relaxed Mermaid parsing for untrusted content.

faq.question: Which Vue versions does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Vue 2.6 and Vue 2.7 projects.

faq.question: When is @vue/composition-api required?
faq.answer: Use it only for Vue 2.6 projects that rely on Composition API patterns.

faq.question: Where should the stylesheet be imported?
How should active chat messages be rendered?
faq.answer: Use automatic smooth streaming and avoid fade during active streaming.

faq.question: Can I render trusted legacy HTML?
faq.answer: Only use trusted HTML on a clearly trusted and scoped surface with a documented reason.

faq.question: When should I use another Markstream package?
faq.answer: Use the CLI package for Vue CLI or Webpack 4, and the Vite package for Vue 2 worker-import cases.
